changelog:
- Initial release of fuxin-doc-qa: a read-only skill for Q&A on currently open Fuxin Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Supports triggers like "问文档", "文档问答", "总结这份文档", "ask_current_document", and similar.
- Retrieves and summarizes full text, outlines, cell or slide content via product-specific read-only tools; strictly prevents any document modification.
- Handles questions, summarization, content locating, and data verification based on the active document.
- Integrates with fuxin-office-bridge for readiness checks and always uses only read-only toolchains.
- Directs any modification needs to corresponding per-product skills (fuxin-word, fuxin-excel, fuxin-ppt).
display_name: 福昕 Office 智能问答
summary: 福昕 Office 智能问答只读取当前活动的 Office 文档内容，不会上传本地文件到云端。用户可以就合同条款、财务报表、项目计划直接提问，AI 会在原文中定位答案并给出引用来源。它适合需要快速理解长文档、核对数据或准备会议内容的用户。
